reviewed_hunks.quote: A 2026-11-08 dual-task scope search kept cognitive-motor dual-task training narrative-only (ADR-052). Gao and Liu 2025 (PMID 40410069) found gait, balance, executive-function and fall-risk gains in community older adults; Hao et al. 2025 (PMID 40304821) network meta-analysed 32 RCTs in MCI/dementia and found dual cognitive-task training best for global cognition. Both are clinical or motor-cognitive populations, so no dual-task mechanic was added. The same update added an optional mnemonic strategy hint to Paired Associates, based on the Chen 2022 strategy-training evidence; it does not change scoring.
